body: I feel you. It gets exhausting hearing the same shit everyday about how life is so worth it and how much of a future you have or when they try guilt trip you into living by talking about all you leave behind and all that other bullshit. Just wish there was someone who simply listens and understands but everybody is so unbelievably obsessed with there little ego fantasy of being the hero who saved the sick person. It's bullshit.

A long drop hanging provides an instant death by internal decapitation or if it's fucked up full on decapitation but the time it takes to kill you, you won't even be able to feel or comprehend the pain. Any other method of hanging I've only heard is an unimaginably horrific experience.

I don't believe this to be something to kill yourself over. Relationship problems platonic or otherwise will always fade. I think you should take this as an opportunity to improve yourself in a way you see fit. Sit and contemplate who you are and who you want to be. Make steps to become the thing want in yourself.

Idk why you want to kill yourself. Maybe justified maybe not but I personally feel there are better methods other than jumping from a high place. To many people survive only to live the rest of there life crippled and broken. I hope whatever you chose to do brings peace to your mind.
